queries.query: "large language model" AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR "network management")
queries.rationale: Broad capture of work applying LLMs to networking tasks (intent-to-configuration, change planning, documentation generation) to map the phenomena and applied use cases.

queries.query: LLM AND (hallucination OR "incorrect output" OR "misconfiguration" OR "unsafe configuration") AND network
queries.rationale: Target studies and reports documenting concrete failure modes and manifest misbehaviour of LLMs when used to produce network changes or configurations.

queries.query: "intent to configuration" OR "intent-to-config" OR "natural language to configuration" AND (router OR switch OR policy OR firewall)
queries.rationale: Locate research on translating operator intent in NL to concrete network configs — core NetOps use-case and frequent failure point.

queries.query: generate-validate-repair AND (network OR "network configuration" OR verification) OR (LLM AND "verify" AND configuration)
queries.rationale: Identify architectures combining LLM generation with validators/repair loops, and evidence for how validation reduces failures in NetOps contexts.

queries.query: formal verification AND (network configuration OR "network verification" OR "policy verification" OR Batfish OR "Header Space Analysis" OR VeriFlow OR NetPlumber)
queries.rationale: Collect canonical deterministic validators, verification tools and their formal guarantees to assess how they can be composed with LLMs as mitigations.

queries.query: AIOps AND (LLM OR "large language model" OR agent) AND (network OR NetOps OR monitoring OR orchestration)
queries.rationale: Map adjacent AIOps literature that addresses automation, anomaly response and the role of learned models in operational pipelines.

queries.query: benchmarks AND (network configuration OR NetOps OR AIOps) AND (dataset OR evaluation OR "benchmark") AND (limitations OR validity OR "threats to validity")
queries.rationale: Find existing benchmarks/datasets, their evaluation protocols, and explicit critiques about construct or external validity for NetOps tasks.

queries.query: LLM tool-augmented AND (tools OR "external tool" OR verifier OR simulator) AND (self-correction OR repair OR "generate-validate")
queries.rationale: Survey methods that augment LLMs with tools or simulators for improved correctness and how those pipelines were evaluated.

queries.query: agentic OR autonomous agent AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR orchestration) AND (safety OR reliability OR "failure mode")
queries.rationale: Search literature on agentic LLMs and safety frameworks applicable to automated NetOps agents and their failure analyses.

queries.query: "network configuration repair" OR "configuration synthesis" OR "intent verification"
queries.rationale: Find specific algorithmic or system work on automated repair/synthesis of configs — potential complementary methods or baselines.

queries.query: metrics OR evaluation AND (correctness OR safety OR robustness OR "operational trustworthiness") AND (NetOps OR "network configuration" OR AIOps)
queries.rationale: Identify proposed metrics and evaluation methodologies used to quantify correctness, safety, and trustworthiness in operational networking tasks.

queries.query: case study OR incident analysis AND (automation OR "AI" OR "LLM") AND network AND (outage OR misconfiguration OR incident)
queries.rationale: Locate real-world or postmortem analyses that reveal how automation/AI has contributed to operational incidents and lessons learned.

queries.query: prompt engineering AND (robustness OR "prompt sensitivity" OR "failure modes") AND (LLM OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Collect evidence on prompt sensitivity, brittleness and strategies for robust prompts relevant to NetOps prompts and templates.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop OR "human oversight" AND (NetOps OR network OR "configuration changes") AND (LLM OR agent)
queries.rationale: Find research on hybrid workflows and the effectiveness of human oversight for preventing or catching erroneous automated changes.

queries.query: datasets AND (network configuration OR firewall rules OR BGP configs OR ACLs OR "network policies") AND (public OR benchmark OR corpus)
queries.rationale: Inventory available open datasets for empirical evaluation and reproducibility for NetOps-related LLM research.

inclusion_criteria: Primary empirical studies, system papers, or datasets directly addressing LLM/ML-driven NetOps tasks or network configuration synthesis/repair.
Papers describing verification and validator tools for network configurations (Batfish, VeriFlow, NetPlumber, Header Space Analysis) including formal guarantees or evaluation.
Work on generate–validate–repair, tool-augmented LLMs, or agentic LLMs with explicit experimental evaluation relevant to operational automation.
Benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation protocols for NetOps/AIOps tasks, plus publications that explicitly discuss benchmark validity or limitations.
Operational case studies, incident reports, or postmortems that describe automation/AI-caused or -mitigated network incidents (publicly available).
Survey or position papers that synthesize failure modes, safety, or trustworthiness concerns for AI agents in operations.
Open-source tool repositories, dataset releases, and public technical reports that enable reproducible follow-up experiments.
exclusion_criteria: Papers unrelated to networking or NetOps (e.g., pure NLP benchmarks) unless they provide transferable methods for safety/verification applicable to NetOps.
Opinion pieces, non-technical blog posts, or paywalled content that cannot be verified against a primary source (unless an equivalent public primary source exists).
Pre-lock internal development notes or unpublished artifacts that are not publicly available (per programme constraint).
Works older than ~2016 that do not contribute foundational methods or are superseded by more recent, relevant work (exceptions for classic verification papers).
Non-English documents when no translation or primary English summary is available.
Benchmarks or datasets without clear provenance, licensing, or reproducibility metadata.
date_rationale: Cover foundational networking verification work (pre-2016) where necessary, but prioritize literature from 2018–2026 with emphasis on 2020–2026 because the rapid emergence of large pretrained models and their application to NetOps occurred in this period; this balances historical foundations (formal verification tools) with the most relevant recent LLM/AIOps research and datasets.
